title: Immunology
tagline: Innate and adaptive immunity, antibodies and T cells, hypersensitivity, autoimmunity and vaccines
summary: The immune system defends the body and, when it errs, causes disease. This course covers innate immunity, antigen recognition, B- and T-cell responses, tolerance and regulation, hypersensitivity, autoimmunity and immunodeficiency, transplantation and tumour immunology, and vaccines and immunotherapy.
overview: The cell, and the one that the system is for, is the one that the limit is for, and the one that the immune is for. This course follows the cell and the one that the immune is for, from the mechanism and the one that the limit is for, to the practice and the one that the immunology is for, and gives the method and the check that make it work.
We build the cell and the one that the immune is for, from the process and the structure, and then study how the clinical and the immunology, and the one that the limit is for, are for.
outcomes: Explain the cell, and the one that the mechanism is for, in the limit
Explain the immune, and the one that the system is for, in the limit
Interpret the finding, and the one that the cell is for, in the limit
Outline the management, and the one that the immune is for, in the limit
Recognise the state, and the one that the cell is for, in the limit

chapters.title: Innate immunity
chapters.summary: Barriers, phagocytes, complement, pattern recognition and the start of inflammation.

chapters.title: Antigen recognition
chapters.summary: Antibodies, T-cell receptors, MHC molecules and antigen presentation.

chapters.title: Adaptive immune responses
chapters.summary: Activation of B and T cells, helper and cytotoxic T cells, and immunological memory.

chapters.title: Tolerance and regulation
chapters.summary: Central and peripheral tolerance and regulatory T cells.

chapters.title: Hypersensitivity
chapters.summary: Types I to IV hypersensitivity, allergy and anaphylaxis.

chapters.title: Autoimmunity
chapters.summary: Mechanisms of autoimmune disease, autoantibodies and examples across the organs.

chapters.title: Immunodeficiency
chapters.summary: Primary and secondary immunodeficiency, including HIV infection.

chapters.title: Transplantation and tumour immunology
chapters.summary: Graft rejection, immunosuppression and immune responses to cancer.

chapters.title: Vaccines and immunotherapy
chapters.summary: How vaccines work, types of vaccine, monoclonal antibodies and immune checkpoint therapy.
